about: Height overrides for the beltline-eastside level. scripts/build-block.mjs uses each value before every other height source. Each value has a source. The story counts come from the research in docs/research/2026-11-02-stage-accuracy-and-characters.md (PR #48); the heights are stories x 3.2 m + 1 m, the same rule as the OSM levels tag, unless the note says otherwise. Not checked against a survey.
